distribution: Local storage only; data files are not hosted on GitHub.
checksum_scope: Every listed Parquet file was read and its SHA-256 compared with the committed checkpoint. Source file and checkpoint database hashes are not reverified by this export.
recovery_instructions: See README.md section 5 and Task 1 reproduction commands in the root implementation record. Obtain movies.txt.gz from the registered source, decompress and verify the source hash, register the current source path, then parse with the pinned versions and recorded parameters. Binary checksums identify this stored run; a new run_id or different Parquet runtime may change binary output checksums.
